mainTitle: 📖 Ethics and Integrity Manual for Digital Platforms
mainDescription: In-depth analysis of violated ethical principles — This document examines how the code of conduct and integrity principles of Wikipedia were systematically violated by administrators against the user WazzimaGiygg (Pedro Henrique Cardona Peres), establishing a reference manual for cases of power abuse on digital platforms.
section1Title: 1. Introduction: The Need for a Digital Ethical Framework
section1Text1: The WazzimaGiygg case exposes a deep digital governance crisis that transcends the borders of Lusophone Wikipedia. This ethics and integrity manual not only documents the specific violations suffered by Pedro Henrique Cardona Peres but establishes fundamental principles that should govern the conduct of administrators and moderators on any collaborative digital platform.
objective3: • Serve as a reference for similar cases
warningEthicalText: The WazzimaGiygg case represents a systemic ethical failure of alarming proportions. The documented violations — doxxing, stalking, abuse of power, slander, defamation, injury, malicious denunciation, criminal association, device intrusion, LGPD and Marco Civil violations — reveal an ecosystem operating on the margins of ethics and law.
section2Title: 2. Fundamental Principles of Digital Ethics Violated
sub2_1Text1: Transparency is an essential pillar of digital governance. In the WazzimaGiygg case, this principle was systematically violated through:
transparencyList: Concealment of real motivations: Administrators masked personal persecution as "platform protection".
Lack of adequate documentation: Critical decisions were made without transparent records.
Absence of adversarial proceedings: The "4-Minute Log" demonstrates the total absence of due process.
Impossibility of effective appeal: Appeal channels are controlled by the same agents who applied the sanctions.
Decisions in closed circles: Decisions were made in private channels, outside public scrutiny.
transparencyWarningText: Transparency was replaced by a system of "summary justice" where administrators act as judges, prosecutors and executioners, without any external oversight or independent appeal mechanism.
sub2_2Text1: The principle of impartiality requires administrators to act without favoritism or persecution. In the documented case:
impartialityList: Masked personal persecution: Chronus publicly admitted monitoring the user outside the platform (wikihounding).
Unequal treatment: While other users commit similar infractions without consequences, WazzimaGiygg was targeted with disproportionate sanctions.
Coordination to neutralize: The coordinated action between Chronus, Edmond Dantès and Little Sunshine evidences a systematic effort to eliminate the user.
Pre-judgment: Decisions were made even before the presentation of "evidence".
Conflict of interest: The same agents who accused also judged and punished.
impartialityInsightText: Impartiality was completely abandoned in the WazzimaGiygg case. Chronus, who initiated the persecution, also participated in the process that led to the block. Edmond Dantès, who validated the accusation, is from the same administrative elite. There was no impartial agent throughout the entire process — only coordinated persecutors.
sub2_3Text1: Privacy violation is one of the most serious offenses documented in this case:
privacyList: Proven doxxing: Public exposure of the civil name "Pedro Henrique Cardona Peres" in indexable public logs.
LGPD violation: Processing of personal data without consent, with deviation of purpose (Arts. 6, 7 and 42 of the LGPD).
Device Fingerprinting: Collection of IMEI and MAC Address for hardware monitoring, beyond the permitted scope.
Metadata collection: Extraction of exif data from photographs to track the user.
Illegal data retention: Access to expired IP logs (violation of the 90-day policy).
Off-wiki monitoring: Tracking activities on social networks and external forums.
dataNoteText: The global CheckUser policy establishes that IP data expires in 90 days. Access to logs older than 150 days proves violation of the data retention policy and constitutes a crime under Art. 154-A of the Penal Code (Computer device intrusion).
sub2_4Text1: Due process is a fundamental right, even on digital platforms:
dueProcessList: 4-minute block: The "4-Minute Log" represents the most flagrant denial of the right to defense.
Absence of evidence presentation: The accusations of email threats were never proven.
Fabricated narrative: Construction of a false story to justify arbitrary sanctions.
Procedural fraud: Little Sunshine "confirmed" in 6 hours what Edmond Dantès said was only "possible".
Absence of appeal: There is no higher instance to contest the decision.
dueProcessWarningText: The "4-Minute Log" is conclusive proof of the denial of due process. In just 4 minutes, the user was judged, convicted and punished — without adversarial proceedings, without defense, without evidence, without appeal. This is the synthesis of the ethical failure in the WazzimaGiygg case.
sub2_5Text1: The principle of integrity requires administrators to act with honesty and rectitude:
integrityList: False accusations: Chronus imputed the crime of threat without evidence.
Fabricated narrative: Construction of a story to justify persecution.
Complicit omission: Edmond Dantès did not contest the hardening of the conclusion.
False legitimacy: Appearance of legitimacy created for arbitrary actions.

section4Title: 4. Systemic Coordination: How Ethics Was Corrupted
section4Text1: The analysis of events reveals a pattern of systemic coordination that evidences the corruption of the ethical process:
step1Text: Chronus initiates false narrative against the user
step2Text: Edmond Dantès says "Possible, difficult to prove"
step3Text: Little Sunshine "confirms" in 6 hours what was only "possible"
step4Text: Sanction applied in 4 minutes, without adversarial proceedings
step5Text: Neutralization of the user with appearance of legitimacy
sub4_1Text1: The "Little Sunshine" pattern represents a coordination mechanism where an agent with more power (or more willingness to abuse) "hardens" the conclusion of a cautious technical analysis to justify arbitrary sanctions.

littleSunshineTable.original: "It's not simple to identify all tracks"

littleSunshineTable.hardened: Little Sunshine: Moves request and "confirms" in 6 hours

littleSunshineText1: • August/2025: Edmond Dantès says "It's not simple to identify all tracks" → Little Sunshine responds "Maybe now it's feasible"
littleSunshineText2: • February/2026: Edmond Dantès says "Possible, difficult to prove with certainty" → Little Sunshine moves the request and "confirms" in 6 hours
littleSunshineConclusionText: There is systematic coordination between the three agents to neutralize the user, regardless of technical evidence.
sub5_1Title: 5.1 SEO Damage as an Ethical Aggravating Factor
sub5_1Text1: The so-called "SEO Damage" represents an ethical violation of extreme severity because:
seoDamageList: Permanence: The association of the victim's name with false accusations remains permanently indexed.
Irreversibility: Even if the content is removed, the effects on search engines persist.
Global reach: Anyone who searches for the victim's name finds the doxxing log.
Professional harm: Employers, clients and partners are exposed to false information.
Reputation destruction: The damage to reputation is permanent and irreversible.
seoWarningText: The Wikipedia doxxing log appears as the second global result on Google for the name "Pedro Henrique Cardona Peres", destroying his professional and personal reputation in an irreversible manner. This is the most serious ethical damage documented in the case.
sub5_2Text1: One of the most perverse aspects of the persecution is the degradation of the user's legitimate contributions:
contributionsList: High-quality contributions: The user produced valuable content for Wikipedia and Wikimedia Commons.
Use as "proof": Their photographs and edits were used to persecute them.
Punishment for work: The administrator punished useful contributions to the platform.
Attack on freedom of expression: Violates Art. 5, IV and IX of the Federal Constitution.
Devaluation of work: The victim's work is devalued and used against them.
contributionsWarningText: The accounts "Fantasmadaserie1100" (Skyscrapercity forum) and "Chadecesio" (Wikimedia Commons) made legitimate and high-quality contributions. The administrator, by persecuting them, not only violated the user's privacy, but also punished useful contributions to the platform — which demonstrates that the persecution was independent of any unlawful act committed by the user. It was pure and simple witch hunting.
section6Text1: Based on the documented violations, we establish this best practices manual for administrators and moderators of digital platforms:
transparencyBestList: All decisions must be documented with clear and justified reasoning.
Open communication channels for users to question decisions.
Public records of all administrative actions (except sensitive data).
Periodic external audit to verify compliance of actions.
Publication of justifications for all important decisions.
Transparency in motivations — never conceal the real reasons behind a decision.
dueProcessBestList: Guaranteed adversarial proceedings: The user must have the opportunity to defend themselves before any sanction.
Reasonable time: No less than 48 hours to present defense.
Presentation of evidence: All accusations must be accompanied by concrete evidence.
Independent appeal: Appeal channels not controlled by the same agents who applied the sanction.
Impartial higher instance: Review of decisions by agents not involved in the case.
Presumption of innocence: The user is innocent until proven otherwise.
privacyBestList: Explicit consent: Any data collection must be authorized by the user.
Legitimate purpose: Data can only be used for the declared purpose.
Minimum retention: Data must be deleted after the legal deadline (e.g., 90 days for IPs).
Anonymization: Whenever possible, data should be anonymized.
Prohibition of doxxing: No personal data may be publicly disclosed.
Protection against excessive surveillance: Monitoring must be limited to what is strictly necessary.
impartialityBestList: No conflict of interest: Administrators cannot act in cases where they have personal involvement.
Equal treatment: All users must be treated with the same criteria.
Prohibition of wikihounding: Monitoring users outside the platform is strictly prohibited.
Peer review: Important decisions must be reviewed by other administrators.
Separation of functions: Investigation, judgment and punishment must be done by different agents.
No persecution: Decisions should not be motivated by revenge or personal persecution.
accountabilityBestList: Responsibility for actions: Administrators must answer for their actions.
Removal mechanisms: Clear processes to remove administrators who abuse power.
Financial transparency: If there are resources, accounts must be rendered.
Periodic reports: Regular publication of administrative activity reports.
Consequences for abuses: Clear and proportional penalties for ethical violations.
Independent audit: Periodic review by independent third parties.

legalEthicsTable.consequence: Fine up to R$ 50 million + moral damages

recommendationsList: Immediate Independent Audit: Complete review of CheckUser logs operated by Edmond Dantès and Johannesn89 to identify access to expired data (>90 days).
LGPD Take-down: Mandatory and definitive removal of Pedro Henrique Cardona Peres's personal data from all public logs and indexers (Google).
Global Demotion: Immediate revocation of the administrator, bureaucrat and checkuser status of agents involved in doxxing and persecution.
Implementation of the Best Practices Manual: Immediate adoption of all recommendations in this manual.
Creation of Independent Ombudsman: External channel for receiving complaints against power abuses.
Review of Automated Blocks: Implementation of a human channel for contesting blocks based on fingerprinting, as per Art. 20 of the LGPD.
Mandatory Training: All administrators must undergo ethical and data protection training.
Notification to ANPD: Investigation into the data processing carried out by the Wikimedia Foundation.
Criminal Action: Filing of action against Chronus, Edmond Dantès and Little Sunshine for slander, malicious denunciation, criminal association, stalking and device intrusion.
Civil Action for Moral Damages: Claim for compensation for the permanent SEO Damage and for the vexatious public exposure.
ArbCom Reactivation: Immediate appointment of new members with fixed terms and independence.
Radical Transparency: Publication of all administrative decisions and justifications.
section9Title: 9. 📢 Call to Action: Restoration of Digital Ethics
callToActionList: Criminal Investigation: Opening of police inquiry to investigate the crimes of slander, malicious denunciation, criminal association, stalking and device intrusion.
Civil Investigation: Civil action for moral and material damages against all agents involved.
Administrative Investigation: Inquiry at the Wikimedia Foundation to investigate UCoC violations.
Notification to ANPD: Formal complaint for LGPD violations.
Notification to WMF: Formal communication about ethical and structural violations.
Global Demotion: Removal of all involved agents from all administrative positions.
Structural Reform: Implementation of all proposed recommendations.
Restoration of the Ideal: Commitment to restoring the ideal of free and democratic knowledge.
section10Title: 10. Conclusion: The Path to Ethical Restoration
finalText1: The WazzimaGiygg case is not an isolated incident, but the symptom of a systemic crisis in Lusophone Wikipedia governance. The documented violations — doxxing, stalking, abuse of power, malicious denunciation, device intrusion and multiple violations of the LGPD and Marco Civil da Internet — reveal an ecosystem operating on the margins of law and ethics.
finalText2: Restoring trust requires concrete and immediate measures: independent audit, removal of personal data, demotion of involved agents and rigorous implementation of good governance practices.
finalText3: The era of technical impunity under the veil of volunteerism must be ended. The sovereignty of privacy and the right to be forgotten must prevail over the abuse of administrative power.
finalText4: The evidence documented in this manual is irrefutable: there is proven doxxing, coordinated persecution (criminal association), malicious denunciation, device intrusion and multiple violations of the LGPD and Marco Civil da Internet. The Wikimedia Foundation has subsidiary responsibility and must be held accountable.
finalText5: This manual serves as a guide and reference for the restoration of ethics on digital platforms. The implementation of its recommendations is urgent and necessary to prevent future abuses and guarantee the integrity of free knowledge.
